text: Dr John Markway invites a few people to [stay at Hill House|trigger|saying yes to an offer], a ninety-year-old Massachusetts mansion where Hugh Crain's wives, his daughter and her companion all died. Among them is Eleanor Lance, [lonely and guilty after years nursing her invalid mother|who_suffers|the lonely and isolated]. The house is built at skewed angles, its doors close on their own, and at night [something pounds at the bedroom door|threat|something unseen]. When [words scrawled on a wall call Eleanor home|images|books, letters and writing], she feels [the house drawing her in|wants|keeping people forever].
